title: 491. Strong Password Checker

examples.explanation: Insert four characters covering upper, digit and length plus one fix for repeats.
Three insertions reach length 6; types are already present.
Length, types and repeat rules are all satisfied.

hints: Count missing character classes (lower, upper, digit) and repeating runs of length 3 or more.
Short passwords need max(missing, 6 - n); right-sized ones need max(missing, repeats fixed by replacements).
Long passwords must delete n - 20 characters; spend deletions on repeats with the best saving per deletion first.
